name: Colosseum
accessibility_notes: Elevators serve some levels, but uneven surfaces and substantial walking remain.
description: Ancient amphitheater and archaeological landmark in the center of Rome.

name: Roman Forum and Palatine Hill
accessibility_notes: The archaeological area includes slopes, steps, and uneven stone paths.
description: Ruins of the civic center of ancient Rome with views from Palatine Hill.

name: Vatican Museums
accessibility_notes: Accessible routes are available, though the museum complex is large and requires substantial walking.
description: Extensive papal collections of art and archaeology, including the Sistine Chapel.

name: Borghese Gallery
accessibility_notes: The museum offers an accessible entrance and lift; contact the venue for current arrangements.
description: Timed-entry museum known for works by Bernini, Caravaggio, Raphael, and Titian.

name: Capitoline Museums
accessibility_notes: Lifts connect the principal floors; the museum spans multiple buildings.
description: Civic museums on Capitoline Hill with ancient sculpture, paintings, and views over the Forum.

name: Pantheon
accessibility_notes: The main entrance and interior are generally accessible, with limited walking inside.
description: Exceptionally preserved Roman monument known for its concrete dome and central oculus.

name: Trevi Fountain
accessibility_notes: The fountain is viewed from a public square that can be crowded and has some steps.
description: Monumental Baroque fountain featuring Oceanus and dramatic carved rockwork.

name: Villa Borghese Gardens
accessibility_notes: Wide park paths allow flexible routes, though distances can be substantial.
description: Large landscaped public park with gardens, fountains, viewpoints, and cultural venues.

name: Trastevere Neighborhood Walk
accessibility_notes: Routes can be shortened, but many streets have cobblestones and uneven paving.
description: Self-guided exploration of a historic neighborhood known for lanes, squares, churches, and restaurants.

name: Appian Way Regional Park
accessibility_notes: Ancient paving is uneven; cycling or walking routes should be chosen for the group's mobility needs.
description: Historic Roman road and surrounding parkland with archaeological sites and countryside scenery.

name: Centrale Montemartini
accessibility_notes: The museum provides step-free access and lifts between exhibition levels.
description: Ancient Roman sculpture displayed inside a former thermoelectric power station.

name: Testaccio Market
accessibility_notes: The modern covered market is on one level, though aisles may be busy.
description: Covered neighborhood market with produce stalls and vendors serving Roman specialties.
